attempts.root_cause: a DevTools probe of the same page answered at once (render loop running, 'Bước 5/5', nothing selected): the page was responsive and the runner was waiting for a DevTools response that never came. BrowserSession._send has no deadline and pending requests are never rejected (ISSUE-EVAL-CDP-SEND-NO-TIMEOUT). The process tree (node + headless Chrome on port 9238) was stopped; its partial films were deleted before the rerun
attempts.repair: none to the harness in this wave (a deadline would turn the hang into a failure, not a pass); rerun at the same commit under a 25-minute watchdog
